text: In the eleventh round. <break time="0.8s" /> Tom put everything he had left. <break time="0.8s" /> Into one last attack. <break time="0.8s" /> And the crowd roared. <break time="0.8s" /> Begging him to finish it. <break time="0.8s" /> Sandel went down once more. <break time="0.8s" /> But he rose at nine. <break time="0.8s" /> And held onto the ropes. <break time="0.8s" /> Covering his face and body with his arms. <break time="0.8s" /> Toms legs were heavy. <break time="0.8s" /> And his knuckles ached. <break time="0.8s" /> And his blows. <break time="0.8s" /> Which had no strength left in them. <break time="0.8s" /> Fell weakly on the young mans shoulders. <break time="0.8s" /> Too tired even to raise his arm. <break time="0.8s" /> In defense. <break time="0.8s" /> He saw Sandels glove coming. <break time="0.8s" /> Toward his jaw. <break time="0.8s" /> And then, all at once. <break time="0.8s" /> Everything went black. <break time="0.8s" /> When he woke in his corner. <break time="0.8s" /> The fight was lost. <break time="0.8s" /> And he could think only. <break time="0.8s" /> That a piece of steak. <break time="0.8s" /> Would have made the difference. <break time="0.8s" /> Tom refused all help. <break time="0.8s" /> And walked out of the hall alone. <break time="0.8s" /> And when a man at a pub. <break time="0.8s" /> Offered him a drink. <break time="0.8s" /> He hesitated and walked on. <break time="0.8s" /> He sat down on a bench in the Domain. <break time="0.8s" /> Afraid to face Lizzie. <break time="0.8s" /> Who was waiting up for him. <break time="0.8s" /> And he felt sick with hunger. <break time="0.8s" /> Then he covered his face with his hands. <break time="0.8s" /> And cried. <break time="0.8s" /> And now at last he understood. <break time="0.8s" /> Why Stowsher Bill had cried. <break time="0.8s" /> In the dressing room so long ago.
